purpose: Pre-run package checks that keep testcase intent aligned with official collage UI helper capabilities.

rules.message: Official collage metric setup must declare each metric row as sourceReport + field. Natural-language-only field setup is not enough for row-scoped UI.
Formula cases must identify each base field by source report and field so the helper can configure the correct official UI row.

require: helperHints.params.formulaSteps[] or testcase steps explicitly use formulaEditor.inlineExpressionArea
formula field tokens identify sourceReport + field
requiredEvidence includes formula.uiState.inlineBuilder or formula.uiState.tokenPicker; domain evidence maps these to formulaEditor.inlineBuilder.state / formulaEditor.tokenPicker.state
rules.message: Official collage formula cases must describe the inline formula-builder path: click expression area, click 插入欄位, select source report, select field, then press operator/number keypad buttons. direct_fill_inline is not product PASS/FAIL evidence.
Tool Bridge response must be conditional on native/irreversible execution state unless the testcase itself is explicitly testing authorization.

forbid: steps that assume a globally visible field option is enough
rules.message: Official collage field selection is row-scoped and source-dependent; testcase steps must not assume global field text is sufficient.

require: requiredEvidence references a frontend observation evidence object
rules.message: Official UI observation cases must declare which UI state is under test. They should not fall back to preview-only selected-field or network evidence.

require: requiredEvidence references the lifecycle evidence object, not only a screenshot or helper status
rules.message: Cases using repeated save/list/reopen/copy/delete/project/date journeys must bind to a shared lifecycle action contract before live execution.

require: requiredEvidence includes projectList.reportRow.state when the case verifies persistence or row-local download
rules.message: Report persistence cases must not judge from save/copy API success alone; they need current-run project-list readiness and row visibility/read-back evidence.
Delete-cancel cases must click the row-local delete action, observe the confirmation modal, cancel it, and prove the row remains; tooltip-only evidence is insufficient.
Date-panel cases must prove the visible panel action and resulting button/request state. Request-body correctness alone is not enough for UI-flow cases.

require: Do not list these as visible dateRange.preset options in panel inventory assertions
If tested, model as composite endpoint-control action with explicit start/end controls and evidence
Prefer a separate package instead of main full-ready flow when current UI support is uncertain
rules.message: The current official UI does not expose 自某日至昨日 / 自某日至今 as single visible preset buttons. Treat them as composite endpoint flows or exclude them from full-ready active packages.
